text:
maria: Customer ticket (AcmeRetail) — sudden 403s after we migrated them to new team seats. They think it's SSO related. Error body: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  \"error\": \"forbidden\",\n  \"message\": \"entitlement_check_failed: plan_features_missing\"
}
```
maria: They hit this on both live and staging tokens, same 403. Repro steps in their ticket: create session via SSO, exchange SAML assertion, call /v1/chat/completions -> 403.
ashok: can you paste the exact curl they used? curious whether token header is mangled or if it's our entitlement gate returning the 403 body.
maria: pasted from customer (redacted):
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer ya29.bad-token\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/chat/completions -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-small\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"hi\"}]}'
```
ashok: that header looks normal. The body clearly mentions plan_features_missing not unauthenticated. So it's entitlement gating but the customer believes it's SSO.
ryan: Customer changed billing plan yesterday and also did a seat migration via SCIM. There is a known eventual-consistency window where entitlement indexer hasn't picked up SCIM updates — could surface as 403s that look like auth failures.
maria: they said the 403 started approx 90s after the plan change though, and they retried several times.
support-bot: [auto] Attached account snapshot: plan=pro-monthly, seats=12, active_users=9, last_scim_sync=1758504250
ashok: last_scim_sync is 71s before the first message. That could be the issue: provisioning job ran but entitlement index hasn't rebuilt for the new team mapping. Need to check entitlement logs for that customer id.
maria: logs from our side (redacted):
```
[2025-12-12T15:45:01Z] entitlement.check start account=acme-retail
[2025-12-12T15:45:01Z] entitlement.lookup -> plan: pro-monthly, seats: 12
[2025-12-12T15:45:01Z] entitlement.result -> MISSING_FEATURE: advanced-routing
[2025-12-12T15:45:02Z] respond 403
```
ryan: interesting — plan shows pro-monthly but feature advanced-routing is missing. Could be plan mapping bug where new plan id wasn't in the feature map used by indexer until a background job applied migration. I've seen this when we add new plan SKUs.
ashok: I'll query the entitlement indexer status and the recent rollout of plan mappers. Give me 5.
sre-oncall: FYI I'm watching indexer lag — there was a small restart at 15:44:30 UTC but the worker resumed. Might have processed backlog at 15:46.
ashok: found a suspicious migration change: yesterday we deployed a mapping patch that adds pro-monthly-v2 SKU. The customer's plan was migrated from pro-monthly -> pro-monthly-v2 during billing migration, but entitlement indexer still resolves features for plain pro-monthly. There's a gap for pro-monthly-v2 -> feature map. That would lead to plan_features_missing even though billing shows pro.
maria: customer sees the string \"forbidden\" and assumed auth. They tried reissuing tokens and SSO multiple times.
ryan: mitigation: temporarily treat pro-monthly-v2 as alias of pro-monthly in the entitlement layer for reads, or add a fallback that interprets plan aliases during the indexer window.
ashok: quick patch applied: in entitlement-service we map pro-monthly-v2 -> pro-monthly for feature resolution. Propagating to indexer now. Patch ID: ent-map-2025-12-12a
sre-oncall: indexer acknowledged mapping and rebuilt account cache for acme-retail at 15:47:03 UTC.
support-bot: [auto] Post-patch account snapshot: plan=pro-monthly-v2 (alias->pro-monthly), seats=12, features=[chat,embeddings,advanced-routing]
maria: asked customer to retry. They report calls now succeed. They also requested clearer error messaging — 403 body should indicate \"entitlement\" not ambiguous \"forbidden\".
ryan: agree. Action item: update 403 error code path to include code field e.g. error.code = entitlement_missing and hint = \"contact billing or wait for provisioning\". Filing infra ticket.
maria: created ticket SUP-6782 -> \"Make 403s from entitlement checks explicit (entitlement_missing)\" and CC'd product/billing.
ashok: also adding an automated detection rule in support console: if customer recently changed plan or SCIM migrated in last 5m, show a banner \"entitlement propagation in progress\" to avoid misleading escalations.
maria: closing thread — resolution: transient plan SKU aliasing caused entitlement lookup to fail, patch applied and customer recovered. Will follow up with billing team to avoid future SKU gaps. :white_check_mark:
